# Alyona Bags

> Alyona Bags supplies cotton and canvas bags and offers wholesale, bulk-order, custom-printing, and business-order services for brands, retailers, organizations, and other businesses.

Alyona Bags is a product catalogue and customer enquiry platform. Retail checkout may be available for individual products where offered. Confirm wholesale pricing, minimum order quantities, customization, availability, and delivery details through the official business enquiry channel. The live catalogue and product pages are the source of truth for current products and specifications.

## Main Website

- [Home](https://alyonabags.com/): Overview of Alyona Bags and links to the current catalogue and business information.
- [About Alyona Bags](https://alyonabags.com/about): Information about the supplier and its cotton and canvas bag business.
- [Contact and business enquiries](https://alyonabags.com/contact): Contact Alyona Bags about wholesale, bulk orders, custom printing, and products.

## Products and Services

The catalogue may include cotton tote bags, canvas tote bags, custom printed bags, promotional bags, and reusable shopping bags. These are broad product types, not a complete or fixed catalogue.

Services include wholesale and bulk orders, custom bag manufacturing, custom logo printing, and corporate and promotional orders. Confirm product-specific options and commercial terms with Alyona Bags.

## Customer Information

- [Frequently asked questions](https://alyonabags.com/faq): Answers about minimum quantities, customization, shipping, quotes, payment, and order tracking.
- [Customer reviews](https://alyonabags.com/reviews): Public customer reviews and information about sharing an experience.
- [Privacy policy](https://alyonabags.com/privacy): How website, account, order, payment, and enquiry information is handled.
- [Terms and conditions](https://alyonabags.com/terms-and-conditions): Terms covering products, orders, payment, shipping, returns, and refunds.

- [XML sitemap](https://alyonabags.com/sitemap.xml): Current public page, category, and active product URLs.

- [Public product catalogue API](https://alyonabags.com/api/products): Public catalogue data; use the linked product pages as the source of truth for current product details.
- [Public category API](https://alyonabags.com/api/categories): Public category data for catalogue discovery.
